target: Global physical land and grounded-ice mask at 21 ka, paired with 0 ka ICE-6G_C baseline
classification: land mask=100 AND ice mask=0 => putatively passable ice-free land; land & ice => blocked for ordinary terrestrial plant dispersal; floating ice blocked; ocean blocked
mask_values: Source sftlf and sftgif are binary 0 or 100; reject intermediate values until reviewed
boundaries: No substitution of current ETOPO+uniform -120m for measured PMIP4 21ka land and ice masks
No fallback to interpolated ICE6GC 0ka land where 21ka source inaccessible
A contiguous climate-suitable land graph is not evidence that a plant actually occupied it or dispersed through it
No current or 21ka species score opened during mask retrieval
No genetic outcome used; previous TTF negative plant identity remains unchanged
outputs: byte-identical original 0ka and 21ka NetCDF with MD5 SHA256 pinned
raster metadata / value frequencies / source coverage quality gate only
